newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN could cut div if 1996/97 result poor.
newsitem.headline: MAN could cut div if 1996/97 result poor.

text.p: German truck and machinery maker MAN AG could cut its dividend in the 1996/97 business year which ends June 30 if its profit is poor, chairman Klaus Goette said on Tuesday.
Goette, who is stepping down as chairman, said one should not assume that the dividend would be increased as a "good-bye" gift.
In the 1995/96 busuiness year, MAN paid a dividend of 12 marks, up from 9.50 marks a year earlier.
Goette said earlier in the day that he expected a good result this year, especially if the economy continues to expand.
He added that its largest unit, the MAN-Nutzfahrzeuge truck division, had recently seen its profit outlook improve.
